name: Monte Carlo Specular Energy Aggregator
definition: A method to compress high-order (third-order) Spherical Harmonics (SH) radiance energy into a compact lower-order (first-order) subspace without pre-training or distillation, preserving specular features.
summary: The Monte Carlo Specular Energy Aggregator compresses high-order spherical harmonics into a low-order subspace via Monte Carlo projection, preserving specular features without teacher-student distillation.
